scope: All failed-candidate tracked files except explicitly authorized runtime/test paths; current task text/evidence only for secret and generated-file sanity. No environment or credential files read. Snapshot before later browser/final-report evidence.

secretSanity.limits: Pattern scan plus scoped diff/source review; does not certify absence of every possible encoded secret. Screenshots require visual review after browser runs.

generatedJunkSanity.ignoredBuildOutputs: Expected .vercel/output and other ignored temporary build files are not staged or published; only tracked/untracked nonignored additions reviewed.

cachePatchReview.notes: Guards reject uncacheable outcomes before mutation; successful category set destructively removed from all older same-signature groups, across radius; raw venues, negatives, TTL, admission and LRU caps preserved.

mutations: New task evidence only. No source/dependency/config/native changes, build, browser, live provider, deployment, commit or push.
